name: What is the process for a full shower replacement with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a full shower replacement with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for a full shower replacement begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and needs. We then move into design planning, often utilizing CAD-supported layouts to visualize your new space, incorporating features like walk-in showers or specific tile choices. Following design approval and permit coordination, our skilled team executes the construction and installation. The final step involves a thorough walkthrough, ensuring every detail meets our high standards of craftsmanship and your expectations. This single point of coordination ensures a streamlined homeowner experience from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our shower replacement process includes consultation, CAD-supported design planning, permit coordination, construction and installation, and a final walkthrough, managed by a single team.
